messages:
leo_docs: Quick note: the Python quickstart demo uses REDWOOD_KEY in the README but all other examples use REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also the snippet imports `Client()` from legacy package. Can someone update before the next publish?

nina_eng: Thanks for catching. Which file exactly?

leo_docs: docs/quickstart/python-starter.md — top example and the docker-compose example both. The compose file also exposes 8080 but the starter app listens on 3000 now.

nina_eng: Oof. I'll open a small PR. Plan: unify env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, swap legacy import to new `from redwood import RedwoodClient`, and update docker-compose port and README run command. Keep the snippet super minimal: server-side call only.

pat_product: Add a short note about not embedding keys in client-side bundles. We had a customer config leak last quarter; keep the security callout.

leo_docs: yes, add a "server-side only" badge and example env file (.env.example) content.

ci-bot: link-check failed on PR #412: docs/quickstart/python-starter.md -> broken anchor to /sdk/python/migration/v3-to-v4.

nina_eng: I'll point it to /sdk/python/migration (existing top-level page) and add an explicit anchor in the migration doc.

nina_eng: Proposed minimal snippet for quickstart:

```py
# minimal quickstart (server-side)
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

resp = client.text.generate(model='redwood-alpha-1', input='Hello from Python quickstart')
print(resp.output[0].text)
```

nina_eng: This avoids long-lived token handling in the quickstart. We'll add an appendix later showing `tokens.rotate()` and a short Flask example.

deploy-bot: FYI the starter Dockerfile we recommend breaks on older buildpacks (alpine base + musl) — switching to debian-slim base in docs fixes local image builds.

leo_docs: added the debian-slim recommendation and a note about Dedicated streaming support: "Streaming responses may not yet be available on Dedicated v1; fall back to non-streaming generation."

pat_product: small editorial: change wording "server only" -> "server-side only (do not embed API keys in frontend)". Also add a link to security best practices.

ci-bot: spellcheck & linkcheck passed for PR #412.

leo_docs: merged and backported to starter-app repo. Thanks everyone! :tada:
